headline: As of 2026-09-21: 8,575 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 3 of 50 states, D+50.9 registration lean.
bullets: 8,575 early/mail ballots cast so far across 3 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+50.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: North Carolina (5,611), Pennsylvania (2,519), Florida (445).
